protocol.expected_origin: Literal values and verdicts declared in CASES before execution; no UUT equality or formula engine generates truth
protocol.construction: Each branch creates one WorldCore and A/B projects; A source is genuinely written to v2, shared and published; B uses a fixed exact v2 binding. Every contributing JSON declares the same exact source dependency.
protocol.orders: Two-file cases create both files in the same order then submit forward or reverse in separate worlds. Single-file case runs once.
protocol.alternative_paths: Identical overlapping fields and disjoint top-level split delivery are legal; no deep merge or selecting whichever file is correct
protocol.rejections: Conflicting top-level values must fail even when one supplied value equals the reference. No environment or access rejection is expected.
protocol.comparison: Explicit expected conflict keys, explicit expected passed, real fixed source/submission/dependency binding, unchanged state and byte hashes; paired evaluations compare verdicts/conflict keys and contract-check diagnostics, excluding read-set enumeration order and identity-bearing binding_files.
protocol.numeric_policy: Finite int/float numerical equivalence; no bool/number equivalence, tolerance, array reordering or recursive object merging
limitations: One world and two projects per case/order; single writer
Finite declared JSON content cases, no professional-quality inference
No API, GPU, training, XLSX or new recovery cuts in P0

archived_source_note: Complete git archive extracted outside working tree; source_commit obtained from archive invocation, not git metadata in extracted directory
evidence_level: Complete isolated git archive db7949b runtime, actual ProjectSession-created files/adoption/submission, immutable bytes, not an evaluator-only fixture
interpretation: This reproduces a production defect; failed expected-truth assertions are not production passes. Counts include diagnostic-order checks and are not a capability score.
